view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large, well-lit warehouse interior. High ceilings feature exposed ductwork and fluorescent lighting. Rows of tall metal racks line both sides, filled with palletized goods. A forklift is parked on the left, while workers in red shirts are visible in the distance. Yellow safety barriers separate aisles from racks. The floor is smooth concrete.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: An orange and gray forklift is parked on the left side of the aisle near a wall. It has a vertical mast and is positioned close to a yellow safety barrier. Its forks are down, and it appears stationary. The forklift is supported by its own wheels on the concrete floor.

objects.label: warehouse rack
objects.observation: Tall black metal racks extend vertically along the right side of the aisle. They are labeled with yellow numbers, including '13' at the bottom. Pallets with various goods, including red crates and boxed items, are stacked on them. The racks are supported by their own structural frame and stand on the concrete floor.

objects.label: worker
objects.observation: A person wearing a red shirt and dark pants is walking in the middle distance, slightly to the right of center. They appear to be moving toward the camera. Their exact actions are unclear due to distance. They are standing on the concrete floor and are partially obscured by the perspective of the aisle.

objects.label: yellow safety barrier
objects.observation: Yellow plastic or metal barriers are installed along the base of the warehouse racks on the right side. They are low-profile and run parallel to the racks. These barriers are fixed to the floor and serve as visual and physical delineators between the aisles and storage areas.

objects.label: ceiling structure
objects.observation: The ceiling consists of exposed metal beams, ductwork, and fluorescent light fixtures. It spans the entire width of the warehouse above the aisles. The structure is supported by the building's framework and is integrated into the overall architecture of the space.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s4-32898", "image_size": [1920, 1080], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
